notes.title: Let's ride into Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Hello Car Traders!

Happy New Year 2021 to all of you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/a65ed51434cf4f1ab672459286c69c4404dfcd1a.png

This time we are going to make a very specific deal. One could say this kind of deal happens only once in a year and it always involves getting something new in exchange for something old. This time we'll dabble in time-trading! 

But no worries, it's not going to be a difficult and risky adventure - you'll not even have to leave your room which in these times is actually quite convenient. The whole deal will happen automatically and you're only required to have a lot of great time and fun! Let's trade the old year for a new one!

And while we're at it - we are happy to wish you a great and happy New Year! Let 2021 be the best year ever for all of us - full of games, food, sleep and awesome deals - both in your Car Trading career and in real-life. Happy New Year! 

Let's trade an old year for a better new one!

Best regards,
Car Trader Simulator team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Merry Christmas from Car Trader Simulator Team!
notes.content:
Hello Car Traders!

Festivities are upon us and we would love to wish you all the best!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/412e024def4e2cf426fd54b93ca9d8849580e460.png

Have you ever thought about dressing up as a Santa? Maybe you've already done that before? Well, the season for such cosplays is upon us so you might as well try practicing your "ho-ho-ho"! After all customers might be more willing to buy cars from a kind gentle figure and maybe you'll even throw in some Christmas discount to sweeten the deal? 

Still, after a hard day at work - you need to rest yourself and this time is the best time to do it! Sit and lean back in your favourite chair, eat up and drink up and recharge the batteries - you'll need a lot of stamina and energy in order to become the best car dealer in the whole world! 

And for now - we would like to wish you good luck with any of the goals you set for yourself! Have a warm, pleasant and merry Christmas among your loved ones and enjoy yourself near the Christmas tree!

Merry Christmas!

Best regards,
Car Trader Simulator team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator - Early Access Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello Car Traders!

Today we have a great news for all of you impatiently waiting to fully start your car trading career. 
The game will be available to be purchased in an Early Access starting from 4th November.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/c35dba045eb181b84385bf3cdf76d83a8dccc4ca.png

As we have received a lot of feedback and opinions during few last weeks we have been trying to make the game as perfect as it could be. At the same time we have heard the community asking for a quicker release of the game - some of you really want to start trading cars left and right right away and we are happy to hear it. 

In order to find a suitable common ground we have decided to release the game in an early access model to accommodate both needs - yours and ours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/8e0d1826f2581772f942e28e06e6dccc4dfe98f0.png

We would love to see you play the game right away. There is nothing that makes us happier than seeing you enjoying yourself with our creations. That is why we have decided to pursue the early access - well, that and some of the messages we received asking for quicker release. As we do understand your interest and enthusiasm we just needed to properly answer them.

At the same time the early access gives us a great opportunity to do two things - work on the further development of the game and respond quickly to your feedback. After the EA release of the game, more than ever, we will be happy to see your opinions, remarks, feedback and criticism regarding the game. We will be excited to welcome positive opinions and humbled to hear what we can still improve in-game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/0ae5e3138905c870f29e731aac5609cfb3257557.png

Start getting ready to fight other traders for the best deals and be on the lookout for more information from us very soon!


Best regards,
Car Trader Simulator team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Campaign in the Full Version
notes.content:
Hello Car Traders

Have you wondered how Campaign Mode will look like in the full version?

⬇ Today we've got some interesting details for you. 👀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/6c9dae2688d9cce16757c053ca020634ffa5ec0f.png

Firstly, the campaign has 27 missions and 3 paths.

These paths are Mafia, Sleek and Lawful.

Each mission is different related to the path you choose to follow. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/b56d3ec7a5bcfb13b05770c9033a10e7ad6db988.png

The lawfulness and decisions you make will decide which one you will be on. 

The missions in the path are divided as follows:

 0-1
 1-3
 4-6
 7-9

❗ You can switch from Mafia to Sleek after 3 missions, but not from Mafia to Lawful. ❗

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/75561837f7f7544a98a0772a649991c9b7ff2ebd.png

Our uncle will give us good advices and support during the game.

What's interesting...

The campaign will include cutscenes and cinematics. 🎦 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31151725/b0ac9e312204c1503c912ee61dd8f774d45fbc1d.png
Image: You will be able to receive Muserati after future updates. 

In the end, do you remember the mission with Paula?

Her persona and the car she sold you is a part of the bigger story. 

That's why you can't sell it in the prologue. 

Best regards
Car Trader Simulator team

notes.title: New Phone and more - Update 1.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570178/5f8011bacdde71a3549c2f905a2168752fb27d03.png

With update 1.1 we wanted to give you something special. We've added "LMG HOME" browser on the new phone where you can find LMGSCOUT and DarkCars. These are new auction portals to give you more possibilities to buy cars. Our next goal is to create more spots where you can sell cars.  We are also working on a new car pricing formula! Thank you for your feedback. It's amazing to receive so many messages with suggestions and ideas on how to improve CTS. Stay healthy and enjoy the new update. If you want to share your ideas with us, do not hesitate to reach us on our Discord channel 
~ Faci  CTS Producer 



Major Patch 1.1

 Added a window that forces you to confirm your action when you want to delete your save file
 Also added "--" and "++" which gives you the possibility to up or down the price by 500$ to make transactions even quicker!
 Balance improvements
 Filters - to find and sell a car easier and faster
 Fixed an issue with loading the game when your thief picks up the car
 Fixed an issue with progress after loading the game
 Fixed an issue with advanced movement control when your employee was on the patrol
 Fixed an issue where opening main menu was unpausing the game
 Improved resolution selection and settings
 Improved the display of thief bail in prison
 Improved French Translation
 New animations
 New auction portals for buying cars: LMGSCOUT and DARKCARS
 New dialogues
 New graphics for bids
 New Phone! 
 New layout
 Negotiation with +/-  can be changed into writing exactly how much you would like to sell a car
 Notebook with information next to the phone - so you will be able to see your expenses and possible profit LIVE according to current offers
 Performance Improvements
 Reduced the amount of text messages received from your employees
 Rework of transactions (f.e. 5 hashtags instead of 3) 
 Tasks refresh properly after loading the game

With your help and suggestions, we fixed many bugs in our prologue. Major issues such as game-saving or screen freezing at the start of the game have been resolved. Finally, we got rid of the tutorial-related bugs. A German translation created entirely by the community of our game has been added.

Update 1.0.0.7

Our changes
Added an option to switch Miles to Kilometres in settings
Added Encyclopedia where players can find detailed explanations of most aspects of the game
Automatic selection of the text when changing the employee/garage name or entering your own amount in the auction
Fixed issues with Inputs/Keybindings
Fixed Save/Load issues
Fixed saving of goals progress in Sandbox mode
Fixed an issue where you could display a car from map legend
Fixed a bug where repeatedly pressing the Escape button would cause Menu buttons disappear
Fixed a bug with cars during the transaction (the car is seen as sold even after the end of the auction / Deal is processing)
Fixed an issue with displaying the logo of your company in Sandbox
If players want to skip the cutscenes now they have to confirm it by pressing the button again
Improved text integrity of the game
Improved loading of campaign mode
Improved visual effects
New mouse cursor
Performance improvements
Visual and mechanical Improvements in Tutorial

Changes with the help of the community
Added a full German Translation thanks to our community
Added an option to exit the tutorial
Improved and expanded Tutorial
From now on players can type in how much they want to offer on auctions 
We’ve added clickable pause/resume controls on the bottom of the screen
We’ve added our community translators in Credits



"Hello everyone, thanks to your feedback we know that it was hard to play and enjoy CTS but we came with some cool solutions for you. We IMPROVED AND EXPANDED TUTORIAL so entering the game should be easier than ever. Everything is BIGGER, CLEANER (in terms of explaining how does stuff works) and WAY MORE EFFECTIVE for players. As a producer, I want to deliver the best possible user experience for each player so we didn't only bring new Tutorial but we've added ENCYCLOPEDIA. It's available on top of the screen on Sandbox and Campaign Mode. We explained most parts of the game with TEXT and GIFS, it's very accessible and simple. It's the best way to get in-depth with Car Trader Simulator. There are more features planned to come in both full game and prologue version so stay tuned for future devlogs and enjoy the update" ~ Kamil, Producer

Best regards
Car Trader Simulator team

notes.title: Devlog #1 - "Tips & Tricks"
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570178/5f8011bacdde71a3549c2f905a2168752fb27d03.png

Today we would like to share with you a few pieces of information, which will be useful while playing Car Trader Simulator Prologue. 🚗🚕🚙

5 Tips & Tricks

1. Plan your road for Thiefs, Player, Mechanics and Drivers!

[olist]
 Hold Shift and Righ Click on the map.
 Plan your road.
 Click ESC to delete it.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570178/5ba8283d860a7c8a0a862f394b926692e08a6f36.gif

2. Need more spaces in the Garage?

[olist]
 Buy your Drivers larger Trailers.
 Hold there Cars.
 Switch the needed Cars between the Trailers and the Garage.
[/olist]

3. Your opinion is crucial! Feel welcome to share with us at any time.


 Bugs and problems.
 Ideas and Suggestions
 Errors in translating the game


4. Is the Car locked from the last buyer, so you can`t change the Colour or Check the Profit-Price?

[olist]
 Switch to another car in the garage and back. 
 It should be displayed. (works only with a second Car)
[/olist]

5. If you feel lost in-game.


 Ask devs - We are here to help you
 Look into YouTubers videos.
 Watch our official tutorial to see and know more. 


[previewyoutube=GlLps6enxHE;full][/previewyoutube]

❗ [UPDATE] Right now our priority is:

 Resolving loading and saving bug.
 Reduction of clicking in the game. 
 Releasing update as soon as possible.
 

Thank you for your active participation in building prologue! We are very happy and thankful for your opinions and ideas. For us, developers, it's a true pleasure to have a great community like that! ❤

Do you know some other tips or tricks? Share with us in the comments below.

Best regards
Car Trader Simulator team
